prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop ecommerce homepage decision comp, landscape 1536 × 1024, for Grădina Kasper.
Primary request: Design the representative homepage for the visual direction “The Greenhouse Packing Table.” The composition must read as a real, production-ready ecommerce website rather than a poster or branding moodboard. A visitor should immediately understand that Grădina Kasper grows vegetables in its own greenhouse, packs them into vegetable boxes, and sells those boxes online.

Input images:
- Image 1, Home.png: style reference only for friendly rounded typography, confident green usage, playful restraint, and real produce imagery. Do not reproduce its mobile layout.
- Image 2, how-it-works.png: concept reference only for clear friendly step communication. Do not copy its execution.
- Image 3, footer.png: binding reference for the existing footer identity, dark-green rounded shell, friendly white type, and restrained simplicity.
- Image 4, random-site.png: catalogue-density and ecommerce inspiration only. Do not copy its generic template styling or product-card proportions.

Scene/backdrop: A warm uncoated paper-colored page with a compact desktop navigation and a dominant hero built around a wide, authentic greenhouse packing photograph: real people’s hands or a grower naturally packing freshly harvested vegetables into a sturdy produce crate on a greenhouse bench, leafy rows and diffused greenhouse light visible, candid and credible, not staged luxury photography. Add subtle physical cues from a working packing table—produce crates, packing slips, greenhouse bench tags, handwritten crop markings, and small imperfect ink stamps—integrated with restraint.

Composition/framing:
- Landscape desktop viewport, 1536 × 1024, straight-on website screenshot.
- Compact navigation across the top with the real Grădina Kasper wordmark/logo treatment on the left, a few restrained Romanian navigation labels, and account/cart controls on the right.
- Below, a large wide rounded-corner greenhouse/packing photograph spanning most of the page.
- Attach a large rounded warm-paper “order ticket” panel to the hero photograph, overlapping the photo naturally like a packing slip clipped or taped to the packing table, while remaining unmistakably a usable ecommerce interface.
- The order ticket must create strong hierarchy: headline, featured box name, price and weight, next delivery date, primary add-to-cart action, and secondary catalogue link.
- At the bottom fold, reveal the beginning of a spacious product-catalogue strip with large vegetable-box cards—each card has generous photography, box name, simple contents cue, price, and friendly rounded action. Products should occupy more space than a generic dense marketplace because there are only 18 boxes.
- Keep controls aligned, plausible, and clickable. Use ample negative space and a disciplined grid. No decorative elements should obscure shopping actions.

Style/medium: premium high-fidelity web UI mockup with editorial ecommerce craft, but friendly, practical, human, and accessible rather than luxury. Rounded geometry with varied radii, thick confident friendly sans-serif type, occasional compact mono/typewriter annotation for packing-slip metadata, tactile uncoated paper and crate-label details, crisp real photography, restrained playful asymmetry. Visual identity should feel grown and packed by a real local team, not rustic cosplay.

Color palette: deep greenhouse green #064F35; pale leaf #D8ED9C; uncoated warm paper #F7F1DF; tomato accent #E65D3F; small crate-brown accent #6D4B35. Use deep green as the primary anchor, pale leaf for supporting fields, tomato only for a small energetic accent, and brown sparingly for physical packing cues. Maintain accessible contrast.

Materials/textures: subtle paper tooth, recycled packing ticket, produce crate wood/cardboard, greenhouse glass diffusion, tiny ink-stamp imperfections; keep textures quiet enough for UI clarity.

Text (verbatim, preserve Romanian diacritics exactly):
“Din grădina noastră. Direct pe masa ta. Proaspăt din Brașov.”
“Cutia Family”
“150 RON”
“4–5 kg”
“Următoarea livrare: 28.09.2026”
“Adaugă în coș”
“Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”

Text placement and hierarchy: the exact headline and every featured-product string must appear clearly and legibly on the large order ticket, without substitutions, English translations, duplicated words, misspellings, or broken diacritics. Primary CTA is “Adaugă în coș”; secondary action is “Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”.

Constraints:
- Show one coherent desktop homepage at approximately 1536 × 1024.
- Preserve every verbatim string exactly.
- Make the hero and order ticket the unmistakable focus.
- Show enough catalogue at the fold to establish the 18-box shopping system.
- Friendly, moderately playful, human greenhouse story, clear ecommerce usability.
- No invented awards, testimonials, review stars, certification marks, organic seals, partner logos, claims, badges, or statistics.
- No changes to routes or business logic are implied by this comp.
- No watermark.

Avoid:
generic ShadCN look, template-dashboard styling, luxury minimalism, sterile wellness branding, overdone farm/rustic motifs, gingham, burlap, chalkboards, faux-vintage signs, farmhouse cosplay, excessive sticker clutter, childish illustration, glassmorphism, gradients, purple, neon, tiny product cards, dense marketplace grids, poster-like composition, floating disconnected panels, unreadable text, irrelevant English copy.
